paite: Huai ni in kumpipa Ahasueras in kumpinu Esther kiang ah Judate melmapa Haman inn apia hi. Kumpipa ma ah Mordekai ahong a; Esther in amah a ding in kua ahia chih agen khinta hi.
heading: Kumpipa Ahasueras Thuseh Thak

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n azungbuh asuah a, Haman a kipan alak, Mordekai kiang ah apeta hi. Esther in Haman inkote tung ah Mordekai akoihta hi.
Esther in kumpipa ma ah thu agen lai a, akhebul a puk in, Agag mi Haman gilou bawl leh Judate siatna ding a alunggel khitsa a lunggelna koihmang ding in khitui toh amah angen ngutngut hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Esther lam ah adangka-eng kumpi chiang alen a. Huchi in Esther athou a kumpipa ma ah adingh hi.

Ama'n, "Kumpipa lungkimna ahih a, amitmuh a deihsakna ka tan a, kumpipa ma a thil dik a alat a, amuh a lungkimhuai ka hihleh, Agag mi Hammedatha tapa Haman in laikhak abawlte kumpipa bial a om Judate hihsiatna ding a agelh sut in om hen.
Huchi lou in ka mite tung a gilou tung ding ke'n bangchi in ka en ngam dia? Ahihkeileh ka tanaute siatna bangchi in ka mu ngam dia?" achi hi.
Kumpipa Ahasueras in kumpinu Esther kiang leh Juda mi Mordekai kiang ah, "Ngai un, Judate tung a akhut akhak ziak in, Haman inkote leh khailupna khuam a akhailuppa uh amah Esther kiang ah apeta hi.

Na deih bang in, kumpipa min in, kumpipa zungbuh a sawn in, Judate kiang ah leng lai gelh un; kumpipa min a lai kigelh, kumpipa zungbuh a kisawn peuhmah, mi kuamah in ahihlamdang thei ngal kei a," achi hi.

Huchi in kumpipa laigelhmite asam ua, akha thumna Sivan kha a, ani sawmnih-le-thum ni in; Judate tungtang thu Mordekai in thu apiak bang in gam heutute kiang leh India a kipan Ethiopia pha a om bialte ukpipate leh vaihawmte, bial zakhat sawmnih-le-sagih, huai a kigelhdan bang zel a bial chiteng kiang, mi chih apau uh dungzui zel in, alaigelh uh bang zel a Judate, apau uh bang zel in akiang uah gelh in a-omta hi.
Kumpipa Ahasueras min in agelh a, kumpipa zungbuh in asawn a, kumpipa nasepna a kizangsek sakol man-gang, hoihtak a vulhte a tuang in sakol tung ah dak in laikhakte akhakta hi.

Huai ah kumpipa'n khopi chiteng a om Judate kikhawmkhawm a, ahinna ua dia pang a, amaute sual ding a anau neute uleh anumeite uh, asum uh gallak a la ding a kisa mite leh bial thilhihtheihna hihse ding leh mangthangsak ding in phalna apia hi.
Kumpipa Ahasueras bial tengteng ah ni khat in, huai bel, akha sawm-le-nih, Adar kha ahi a, ani sawm-le-thum ni geih in.
Bial chih a piak ding chi a thupiak, kigelh a teisawn mite tengteng kiang ah suah in a-om a, huai ni chiang a Judate'n amelmate uh tung a phu la dia mansa a a-om chiat theihna ding un.
Huchi in dak kumpipa nasepna a zat sakol man-gangte tung a tuangte apaikhia ua, kumpipa thupiak in amau anoh in akhawksak ngal ua; thupiak pen Susa Inpi a piakkhiak ahi.
Huchi in Mordekai bel kumpi puandum leh kang, dangka-eng lallukhu thupitak toh, puanaktual puanmalngat hoih leh sandup toh kumpipa ma a kipan apaikheta hi: Susa khopi akikou a, akipak hi.
Huchi in Judate'n kouzanna leh kipahna, nopna leh zahna anei uhi.

Bial chih leh khopi chih a koi lai peuh a kumpipa thupiak leh athubawl paina peuh ah, Judate'n ankuangluina leh ni hoih kipahna leh nopna anei uhi. Huchi in gam a mite lak a tampite Judate ahong hi ua; Judate launa lah atung uah ahong omta hi.
